plugin.name: Tables
plugin.description: The tables and columns of the catalog's mapping: browse them, fetch rows, and query the versions of time-versioned tables.
message.refreshed: {count} tables read, {missing} missing in the database
message.refreshedNoSource: {count} tables read; no data source to compare with
warn.mapping: The mapping file is not available; see the catalog's index report
warn.missing: {table} is in the mapping but not in the database
field.key.hint: Value of {key}; several key columns: comma-separated
error.mapping: The catalog's mapping could not be read
error.noSource: No data source: set one in the environment (datasource) or the workspace (datasource.default)
error.period: Enter a valid start and end
error.noDeleted: The mapping gives this table no deleted flag and no end time
step.refreshing: Reading the mapping and the database's tables…
overview.title: Tables
overview.about: The table tree shows what the last refresh read: the catalog's mapping, and which of its tables the database has (environment datasource, else datasource.default). Refresh after changing either.
overview.none: Not loaded yet: run “Refresh from the database”.
warn.sourceFailed: The database could not be read, so nothing is marked missing: {error}
error.snapshotTooLarge: The mapping is too large to store
error.noRows: the data source returned no rows (it needs to support inline results)
ai.tool.listTables: Lists the mapped tables and their columns (entity, table, field, column, description).
ai.tool.runSql: Runs one read-only SELECT or WITH statement on the database of the AI environment. Use the table and column names from list_tables. Use a read-only database role for the data source of free queries.
ai.sql.notSelect: Only SELECT or WITH statements are allowed.
ai.sql.forbiddenFunction: “{name}” is not allowed in a free query (it acts on the server or reads files).
ai.sql.unicodeEscape: Names written as U&"…" are not allowed in a free query.
ai.sql.systemSchema: “{name}” is a system catalog; a free query only reads the mapped tables.
